Second deterministic-plan audit batch — 2026-09-05

Revalidated every owned blob against `origin/main@9e6a0e436520f67962c22dc244d7b4f77f5bee45` and updated four open leaves through the repo-local CLI fallback (rebar MCP unavailable):

- `nonlineal-crotchety-galago` (`51fb-a3b6-ac66-4c60`): 7 files, 10 stable docstrings; five already-concise/load-bearing ranged comments are now explicitly protected.
- `dripping-viperous-chickadee` (`a578-8751-ec4f-4369`): 9 files, 34 stable blocks; composite ranges were split/anchored, two concise rationale blocks protected, and post-audit Terraform files excluded from this legacy inventory.
- `twofaced-oppressed-nurseshark` (`6f06-6920-8439-4642`): 13 files, 18 stable blocks; module-size helper consumption and its focused companion test are explicit.
- `actinium-abominable-anole` (`4458-5aec-af9b-4534`): 18 files, 43 stable blocks; the vague `and held-out narration` scope became exact IDs, six concise/load-bearing blocks are protected, and current basetemp/close-precheck/run_shape contracts replace stale audit text.

All four descriptions now require immutable before/final `type_comments=True` AST comparison with only `ast.TypeIgnore.lineno` normalized, exact non-allowlisted comment/directive/runtime preservation, and one independent TSV row per edited block with immutable citations plus the three required PASS fields. Each ticket has five structured commands: focused pytest (including real source/path consumers), scoped Ruff check+format, comment hygiene, owned-path `git diff --check`, and worktree-venv `make verify`.

Readback matched the prepared descriptions, exact file-impact sets, declared block counts (105 total), and command arrays. All four remain open, unassigned, and unsigned. No plan review, code edit, claim, transition, close, test/gate execution, commit, or push was performed.
